# Stage

The scene backdrop.

`LL.Stage` · Shell

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Stage>…</LL.Stage>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Stage">…</x-import>
```

## Props (StageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `string` | Scene art URL (a Backgrounds or Cards asset). It is darkened, warmed and slightly blurred. |
| `focus` | `string` | CSS background-position for the art. Default "center". |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Overlays: a Constellation, captions, an archive grid. Position them absolutely or fill the stage. |
